name: tiendasaas
description: Multi-tenant online store service for local businesses (Vendure + Mercado Pago).

scripts.dev: concurrently --names server,storefront --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev -w @tiendasaas/server" "npm run dev -w @tiendasaas/storefront-reference"
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d database storage storage-init
scripts.build: npm run build -w vendure-plugin-mercadopago -w @tiendasaas/commerce-core && npm run build -w @tiendasaas/server && npm run build:dashboard -w @tiendasaas/server && npm run build -w @tiendasaas/storefront-reference
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e
